newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures erode gains late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures erode gains late.

text.p: Jan 28 - U.S. debt futures eroded gains as late trading picked up again. March T-bond futures pulled back below intraday support near 110-20/32, a level some technicians said it needed to close above to continue staying firm nearterm. Some said Monday's low at 109-19/32 could be a near-term bottom if more US inflation data this week prove uninspiring. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
